notes: Codex-app routing cases. Positives cover every conversation the Codex app's sidebar exposes, body-derived titles, same-repository relevance, and scheduled organization. A ChatGPT-history request triggers whether or not the user names the sidebar: the skill inventories those conversations and reports them as `not title-mutable` rather than staying silent and letting an agent improvise. Negatives protect other clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, browser tabs), generic Git cleanup, and ordinary conversation summaries. The held_out split is the final untouched test set, matching the repository's active-skill eval convention.
